"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Input validation
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (log probabilities must be nonpositive)")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
    # Check shape consistency
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All three matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    # Compute normalized weights
    H = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(H)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)
    # Compute losses
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)          # shape (n_candidates,)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
    L_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    return keep, margins
